北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友们，体感 2℃，早晚温差大，注意保暖防干燥哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing, it's sunny but feels like 2℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪天气晴朗，体感 11℃ 很舒适，适合户外活动，享受好天气吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels great at 11℃. Enjoy the lovely weather!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，体感 8℃ 稍凉。出门别忘添衣，感受这美好的春光！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and cool at 8℃. Remember an extra layer to enjoy the day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，体感 16℃ 暖和。风力 3级，出门防风，祝您愉快！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 16℃. A gentle breeze, have a wonderful day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗宜人，体感 19℃ 很舒服。抓住好时光，享受暖阳吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant at 19℃. Enjoy the warmth and sunshine!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 7℃ 凉意十足。早晚温差大，注意加衣，别着凉哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels cool at 7℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 7℃ 略冷。风干物燥，及时补水，别忘了保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but feels chilly at 7℃. It's dry, so hydrate and keep warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 10℃ 适中。湿度稍高，记得带伞，保持好心情！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and 10℃. A bit humid, take an umbrella and stay cheerful!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光正好，体感 9℃ 略有凉意。出行添衣，尽享这明媚春光！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and feels cool at 9℃. Dress appropriately and enjoy the bright day!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 6℃ 较冷。空气干燥，注意保湿，多喝热水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels cold at 6℃. It's very dry, moisturize and drink water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 12℃ 适中。湿度偏高，记得带伞，保持愉快心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and 12℃. Humid, so carry an umbrella and stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，体感 -21℃，风力 3级。请务必穿厚实，谨防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -21℃. Dress very warmly to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -6℃ 寒冷。出门加厚保暖，注意防滑，照顾好自己！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels cold at -6℃. Dress warmly and watch your step!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 9℃ 稍凉。风力 3级，出门添衣，小心着凉哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels cool at 9℃. A gentle breeze, dress warmly!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 15℃ 温和。风力 3级，海边风大，注意防风保暖！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and warm at 15℃. Windy, especially by the sea, stay cozy!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 2℃ 寒冷。早晚温差大，出门注意添衣，别着凉！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cold at 2℃. Dress warmly, especially in the morning/evening!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 1℃ 寒冷。注意保暖防寒，多穿一点，照顾好身体！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and feels cold at 1℃. Dress warmly to keep out the chill!
